plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Confirm GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed available with sufficient VRAM

plan.title: Explore dataset structure and statistics
plan.description: Load annotations.json, count images, annotations, categories. Compute per-image annotation stats (min/max/mean/median). Check image dimensions. Examine category distribution (how many categories have <5 annotations). Look at 'corrected' field distribution. Explore metadata.json structure and products/ directory layout.
plan.success_criteria: Full understanding of data: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, category frequency distribution, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Explore store sections and image naming
plan.description: Identify the 4 store sections (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker) from image filenames or metadata. Count images per section. Understand image_id extraction from filenames. Check if annotations have section info.
plan.success_criteria: Clear mapping of images to sections, counts per section documented

plan.title: Explore reference product images
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory structure. Count how many categories have reference images. Check image types available (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.). Cross-reference with metadata.json to understand coverage. Sample a few to understand visual quality.
plan.success_criteria: Know exactly how many of 357 categories have reference images, what types, and quality

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json. Split by image, stratified by store section. Use seed=42. Target ~223 train, ~25 val images. Output both as valid COCO-format JSON files.
plan.success_criteria: Two COCO-format JSON files created with proportional section representation, all annotations for each image kept together

plan.title: Write evaluation function
plan.description: Implement eval function using pycocotools COCOeval. Compute detection_mAP@0.5 (all predictions mapped to single category) and classification_mAP@0.5 (with correct category_id). Combine as val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Test with dummy predictions to verify correctness.
plan.success_criteria: Function returns correct val_score, tested with known inputs

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write converter from COCO JSON to YOLO txt format (one txt per image with class x_center y_center width height). Create dataset YAML config for ultralytics. Handle the train/val split properly.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format labels created for all images, dataset.yaml validated

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Run inference on val split, evaluate with our metric. This establishes the floor.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score computed and logged

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n by at least 0.05 val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n documented

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score over YOLOv8s
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous models

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l provides meaningful improvement for 357-class detection
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs.
plan.success_criteria: val_score logged and compared

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x is the best single YOLO model for this task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Determine if the extra capacity helps with 357 classes.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to all previous model sizes, best model size identified

plan.title: Best YOLO model at 1280px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Doubling resolution from 640 to 1280 improves val_score by 0.05+ due to small product visibility
plan.description: Take the best model size from steps 8-12, retrain at imgsz=1280. Reduce batch size as needed. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from resolution increase documented

plan.title: Longer training: 300 epochs at best resolution
plan.hypothesis: More epochs improve convergence for 357 classes
plan.description: Train best model size at best resolution for 300 epochs with patience=50. Compare to 100-epoch version.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from longer training documented

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection-only) at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to classify
plan.description: Convert all annotations to category 0. Train YOLOv8x nc=1 at imgsz=1280, 300 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. This model will be the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 higher than nc=357 model's detection_mAP

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning on best model
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold (0.4-0.8) and score threshold (0.05-0.3) improves val_score by 0.01-0.03
plan.description: Grid search over NMS IoU thresholds [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8] and confidence thresholds [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3] on val split using best model. No retraining needed.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/conf thresholds identified, val_score improvement documented

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA adds 0.01-0.02 to detection mAP with acceptable inference time
plan.description: Run best model with augment=True on val split. Measure val_score improvement and inference time. Check if it fits within 300s budget.
plan.success_criteria: TTA val_score and timing documented

plan.title: Build DINOv2-base embedding pipeline
plan.description: Implement: (1) Extract crops from val images using ground-truth or predicted boxes. (2) Run DINOv2-base (from torch.hub or timm) to get embeddings. (3) Build gallery from reference product images + training crops. (4) kNN classification. Test pipeline end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces category predictions for each detection crop

plan.title: DINOv2-base classification on GT boxes
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base kNN classification achieves classification_mAP@0.5 > 0.15 on ground-truth boxes
plan.description: Using ground-truth val boxes, extract crops from original resolution images, embed with DINOv2-base, classify via kNN against gallery. Measure classification accuracy and classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Classification quality baseline established on perfect detections

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: Combining reference images and training crops in gallery outperforms either alone
plan.description: Test 3 gallery configurations: (a) reference images only, (b) training crops only, (c) combined with different weightings. Measure classification accuracy on val GT boxes.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: kNN hyperparameter tuning
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and distance weighting improve classification by 0.02+
plan.description: Sweep k=[1,3,5,7,11], distance metrics [cosine, L2], and voting schemes [majority, distance-weighted, softmax-temperature] on val split with GT boxes.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN configuration identified with val_score improvement

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Combine nc=1 detector (step 15) with DINOv2 classification (best config from steps 19-21). Run full pipeline on val split. Compute val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best single nc=357 model

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO nc=357 + DINOv2 fallback
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification
plan.description: For each detection from nc=357 model: if YOLO class confidence > threshold, use YOLO class; else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep confidence threshold on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over either approach alone

plan.title: RT-DETR-l baseline at 640px
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l achieves competitive val_score and provides architectural diversity for ensembling
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs using ultralytics 8.1.0. Compare val_score to best YOLO model.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score logged, comparison to YOLO documented

plan.title: RT-DETR-l at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l benefits from higher resolution similarly to YOLO
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l at imgsz=1280, 300 epochs. Compare to 640px version and to best YOLO at 1280.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared across resolutions and architectures

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves val_score by 0.02-0.04 over best single model
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and best RT-DETR on val split. Merge predictions using Weighted Boxes Fusion from ensemble-boxes. Tune WBF IoU threshold and model weights.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference with best detector
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference at 1280px with overlap improves detection of small products by 0.03+ mAP
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split each image into overlapping 1280×1280 tiles (stride ~960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Test on val split. Measure detection_mAP improvement and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improvement documented, inference time within budget

plan.title: Tiled inference with smaller model (YOLOv8m)
plan.hypothesis: A smaller model with more tiles may match or beat a larger model on fewer tiles, with better time budget
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m at 1280, use tiled inference with more overlap. Compare val_score and inference time to YOLOv8x tiled.
plan.success_criteria: Tradeoff between model size and tiling density characterized

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large improves classification_mAP by 0.03+ over base due to better fine-grained features
plan.description: Build gallery and classify val crops using DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14). Compare classification accuracy to DINOv2-base. Measure model size and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Classification improvement quantified, size/time tradeoff documented

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A small MLP trained with ArcFace/SupCon loss on DINOv2 features improves classification by 0.02+
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train a 2-layer MLP projection head using contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Use the projected embeddings for kNN classification on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: Multi-crop embedding averaging
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations reduces sensitivity to box boundaries
plan.description: For each detection, extract 3 variations: original crop, center-zoomed (10% padding removed), padded (10% extra context). Average DINOv2 embeddings before kNN lookup. Compare to single-crop.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improvement documented

plan.title: Training with close_mosaic=100 and label_smoothing=0.1
plan.hypothesis: Longer clean fine-tuning and label smoothing improve val_score for dense multi-class detection
plan.description: Retrain best YOLO config with close_mosaic=100 (instead of default) and label_smoothing=0.1. 500 epochs.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over default training settings

plan.title: 500-epoch training with best hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Extended training to 500 epochs with patience=100 improves convergence for 357 classes
plan.description: Train best model configuration for 500 epochs. Monitor for overfitting. Compare to 300-epoch version.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement or plateau identified

plan.title: Progressive resizing: 640→1280
plan.hypothesis: Starting at 640 for 100 epochs then switching to 1280 gives faster convergence and comparable quality
plan.description: Train best model at 640 for 100 epochs, then resume at 1280 for 200 more epochs. Compare val_score and total training time to direct 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: Training time savings documented, val_score compared

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Synthetic augmentation from reference product photos improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste: extract product images from data/products/, apply perspective warp and lighting adjustments, paste onto shelf backgrounds. Focus on categories with <5 training annotations. Retrain with augmented data.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, especially for rare categories

plan.title: Class-balanced focal loss training
plan.hypothesis: Focal loss or class-balanced sampling improves detection of rare categories
plan.description: Train with focal loss (if supported in ultralytics 8.1.0) or implement class-balanced image sampling. Compare per-category detection rates.
plan.success_criteria: Improvement in rare category detection without hurting common categories

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Identify annotations with corrected=True. Duplicate these in training data (2-3x). Retrain and compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from annotation quality weighting

plan.title: Rectangular inference (rect=True)
plan.hypothesis: Rectangular inference preserves aspect ratio better and improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run best model with rect=True during inference. Compare val_score to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison documented

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Using shelf section context improves classification of ambiguous products
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data. For each val image, identify likely section from high-confidence detections, then boost probabilities of co-occurring categories for uncertain detections.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement from co-occurrence priors

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling on test-time gallery augmentation
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test crops to gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: First pass: run full pipeline on val images. Second pass: add crops with score>0.85 to DINOv2 gallery, re-classify all detections. Measure classification improvement.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement from pseudo-labeling

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens is more robust to occlusion than global embeddings
plan.description: Instead of CLS token, use DINOv2 patch tokens. Implement patch-level matching between query crop and gallery entries. Compare classification accuracy to global embedding approach.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison documented

plan.title: Per-category adaptive classification thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Category-specific confidence thresholds improve overall classification mAP
plan.description: For each category, find optimal confidence threshold on val split. Categories with unique packaging get low thresholds (easy to classify), similar-looking products get high thresholds (fall back to category_id=0 when uncertain).
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: WBF ensemble: multi-scale YOLO (640 + 1280)
plan.hypothesis: Combining predictions from different input scales catches products at different sizes
plan.description: Run best YOLO at both 640 and 1280 on val images. Merge with WBF. Compare to single-scale.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from multi-scale ensemble

plan.title: Full ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR + tiling + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: The full pipeline achieves the highest val_score
plan.description: Combine: (1) best YOLO at 1280, (2) RT-DETR at 1280, (3) tiled inference, merge detections with WBF, classify with best DINOv2 config. Measure total val_score and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score achieved, inference time within 300s budget

plan.title: ONNX export and inference time benchmarking
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is faster than PyTorch, enabling more complex pipelines within 300s
plan.description: Export best YOLO and DINOv2 models to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference time on val split using onnxruntime-gpu. Compare to PyTorch inference time.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX inference time documented, speedup quantified

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 YOLO loses <0.01 val_score but saves 50% model size
plan.description: Quantize best YOLO to INT8 via ONNX post-training quantization. Measure val_score drop and size savings. Determine if freed budget enables DINOv2-large.
plan.success_criteria: val_score drop <0.01, size reduction >40%

plan.title: Optimal weight budget allocation
plan.hypothesis: The best val_score comes from optimal allocation of 420MB across detector + classifier
plan.description: Test configurations from the feasibility matrix: (a) YOLOv8x FP16 + DINOv2-base, (b) YOLOv8l FP16 + DINOv2-large, (c) YOLOv8x INT8 + DINOv2-large, (d) two detectors + DINOv2-base. Compare val_scores.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal weight budget allocation identified

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE contrast enhancement
plan.hypothesis: CLAHE improves detection on poorly-lit shelf images
plan.description: Apply CLAHE preprocessing to val images before detection. Compare val_score to unprocessed images.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison documented

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs standard NMS
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS preserves more true detections on dense shelves
plan.description: Replace standard NMS with Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay) in post-processing. Tune sigma parameter on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with standard NMS

plan.title: Train nc=1 detector with tiling-optimized settings
plan.hypothesis: A detector trained specifically for tiled inference (smaller objects, different augmentation) performs better with SAHI
plan.description: Train nc=1 YOLOv8x at 1280 with augmentation settings optimized for tile-based inference (less mosaic, more small-object focus). Test with SAHI on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improvement over standard training + SAHI

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding similarity as additional signal during box fusion improves both detection and classification
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from ensemble, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between crops. Weight boxes higher when embeddings agree across models.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Train with 1600px or 1920px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Training at near-native resolution preserves more product detail
plan.description: Train best model at imgsz=1600 or 1920 with gradient accumulation to compensate for small batch size. Compare val_score to 1280.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement documented, training feasibility confirmed

plan.title: Build complete submission pipeline
plan.description: Create run.py that: loads model weights, processes input images, runs detection (with tiling if beneficial), runs classification (DINOv2 if beneficial), outputs predictions.json in correct format. Test on val split.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct output format, val_score matches experimental results

plan.title: Inference time budget optimization
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing the inference pipeline keeps total time under 300s for ~50 test images
plan.description: Profile each component (detection, tiling, DINOv2 embedding, kNN) on val split. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize: batch DINOv2 inference, precompute gallery, minimize I/O. Target <300s total.
plan.success_criteria: Total inference time <300s on val split (scaled to expected test set size)

plan.title: Final hyperparameter sweep on best pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Fine-tuning all thresholds jointly yields 0.01-0.02 additional val_score
plan.description: Joint optimization of: NMS IoU, confidence threshold, WBF parameters, kNN k, classification confidence gate, DINOv2 temperature. Use grid search or Bayesian optimization on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Maximum val_score achieved with optimized hyperparameters

plan.title: Verify submission constraints compliance
plan.description: Check: total weight files ≤3 and ≤420MB, no blocked imports in run.py, no .bin files, ONNX opset ≤20, pathlib instead of os. Run run.py in simulated sandbox conditions.
plan.success_criteria: All sandbox constraints satisfied

plan.title: Ablation study: contribution of each component
plan.hypothesis: Understanding component contributions helps prioritize what to include in final submission
plan.description: Measure val_score with: (a) detection only (all cat=0), (b) + YOLO classification, (c) + DINOv2 classification, (d) + ensemble, (e) + tiling, (f) + TTA. Document marginal contribution of each.
plan.success_criteria: Clear ranking of component contributions to val_score

plan.title: Document best configuration for human operator
plan.description: Write clear documentation of: best model architecture, training hyperparameters, data preprocessing, inference pipeline settings. Include exact commands for retraining on full 248 images.
plan.success_criteria: Human operator can reproduce training with documented config

plan.title: Robustness check: val_score stability across different val splits
plan.hypothesis: val_score is stable (±0.02) across different random seeds for the split
plan.description: Run best pipeline on 3 different val splits (seeds 42, 123, 456). Check if val_score is consistent or if we're overfitting to the specific val set.
plan.success_criteria: val_score variance <0.02 across splits

plan.title: Final submission package preparation
plan.description: Create submission.zip with: run.py, model weights (≤3 files, ≤420MB), any helper files. Verify it runs correctly with: python run.py --input data/train/images --output predictions.json
plan.success_criteria: Submission zip created, tested end-to-end, val_score matches expectations
